title.rendered: E-Scrap Sorting with Artificial Intelligence – TOMRA Autosort Optical Sorter

content.rendered:
TOMRA Autosort sorting e-scrap using artificial intelligence.

The TOMRA AUTOSORT Fines optical sorter, used in electronics recycling or e-scrap processing, utilizes 4 different technologies combined in one unit to improve your electronics recycling end products, whatever they are. The 4 sensors are:

  • Ultra-High Resolution near infrared spectrometer;
  • Camera detection;
  • High resolution metal sensors;
  • Deep LAIser object detection with AI (artificial intelligence).

Test your own material and see what separation is possible at https://vdrs.com/test-your-recycling-material/
